decision: Establish a bounded multi-agent control plane before broad parallel business-logic implementation.
constraints: no unauthorized Production payment/fulfillment mutation authority

decision: Use domain ownership plus independent constitutional and falsification gates; builder agents may not self-approve or self-merge.

Begin implementation with control-plane/domain normalization, then Membership, Commerce and Governance as the first feature wave; Payments initially protects existing proven settlement behavior and defines integration contracts.
